    Verifying the trace–reject condition #

    Sufficient conditions for the trace–reject condition (2.4) at an object X, used to check it on indecomposable objects whose traces and rejects are known explicitly:

    • traceRejectCondition_of_prop: X ∈ F;
    • traceRejectCondition_of_eq_top: r(X) = X = t(X);
    • traceRejectCondition_of_quotient: the general case, with the quotient X / r(X) presented by an epimorphism π : X ⟶ Q whose kernel is r(X); the third condition is then the equality t(Q) = image(t(X) → Q).

    reject_coe_eq_mk_ofLE verifies the second condition r(t(X)) = r(X) from representatives of the subobjects.

    source
    theorem PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.reject_coe_eq_mk_ofLE {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] [HasLength C] {F : Subcategory C} {X : C} (hF : F.IsSubobjectClosed) {t r : CategoryTheory.Subobject X} (h : r ≤ t) {A B : C} (ι : A ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono ι] (κ : B ⟶ A) [CategoryTheory.Mono κ] (ht : t = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk ι) (hr : r = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp κ ι)) (hA : Subcategory.reject A F = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk κ) :
    Subcategory.reject (CategoryTheory.Subobject.underlying.obj t) F = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk (r.ofLE t h)

    r(t) = r as subobjects of t, from representatives: t = mk ι, r = mk (κ ≫ ι) and r_F(A) = mk κ.

    theorem PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.traceRejectCondition_of_quotient {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] [HasLength C] {T F : Subcategory C} {X : C} (hT : T.IsQuotientClosed) {Q : C} (π : X ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi π] (hker : CategoryTheory.Limits.kernelSubobject π = Subcategory.reject X F) (h1 : Subcategory.reject X F ≤ T.trace X) (h2 : Subcategory.reject (CategoryTheory.Subobject.underlying.obj (T.trace X)) F = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk ((Subcategory.reject X F).ofLE (T.trace X) h1)) (h3 : T.trace Q = CategoryTheory.Limits.imageSubobject (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (T.trace X).arrow π)) :
    TraceRejectCondition T F X

    The trace–reject condition from a presentation of the quotient X / r(X) by an epimorphism π : X ⟶ Q.
